description: Three OMAFRA resource members locate licensed fish processors, dairy plants and meat-processing facilities. The meat layer describes point locations, contact and processing information for abattoirs, freestanding meat plants and further-processing plants. Its bilingual title incorrectly labels the French half dairy plants while its English title, descriptions and native service identify meat plants. Dairy metadata states that licensing concerns food safety, not plant size or production volume, and gives a March 2025 source date. Native ArcGIS item metadata confirms three distinct feature services. They are curated together as related processing-plant inventories, with separate identities and no assertion of equal fields, operating capacity or a complete food-supply network. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue preserves source identifiers and descriptive metadata. Provider: Ontario Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs. Licence: Open Government Licence – Ontario. Costs and current file access are unverified. Access metadata says public; isopen is false. No linked dataset, workbook, document, archive or model/code body was retrieved. Specific simulation applications beyond the stated role are unknown. Related source components retain their own identities. Geographic coverage is Ontario.
